# ManaWG

> ManaWG is a free flat-share app (a WG, or Wohngemeinschaft, is a shared flat in Germany). Flatmates split expenses, keep a shared shopping list, run a rotating cleaning rota and agree things on a noticeboard. The app runs in the browser and can be installed on the home screen without an app store.

Note on the name: ManaWG is a household app for shared flats and has nothing to do with WireGuard.

## Features

- Split expenses: equally or with custom amounts per person, balances, settling up with as few transfers as possible
- Fixed costs and monthly statement: recurring costs such as rent or internet
- Import: bring in matching CSV files from Splitwise and Splid (preview, undo); read a photo or screenshot of an expense list with text recognition, a receipt photo on a single expense is an attachment only
- Shopping list and supplies: one list for everyone, ticked-off purchases can be booked straight as an expense
- Cleaning rota: tasks repeat, rotate fairly, and absent flatmates are skipped
- Calendar (also as a calendar subscription), noticeboard and chat

## Getting started

1. Create a flat at https://app.manawg.com/signup?action=create
2. Flatmates sign in and join with an invite link
3. Add the first expense, shopping item or cleaning task

## Details

- Price: free
- Languages: English and German
- Platform: web app (PWA) for iPhone, Android and desktop
- No ads; data is stored in Frankfurt am Main (EU)
